record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Dynamical Systems
record.original_question: Let f be a C^∞ diffeomorphism of the annulus T¹ × [-1,1] that preserves Lebesgue measure, is homotopic to the identity, has only finitely many periodic points, and whose boundary rotation number α is Diophantine. Must f be C^∞-conjugate to the rigid annulus translation R_α(θ,r) = (θ + α, r)?

evidence.quote: Is f C∞-conjugated to Rα(θ; r) = (θ + α; r) ?

artifact.category_tag: smooth conjugacy rigidity of annulus diffeomorphisms
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface a published resolution of this specific rigidity question for area-preserving $C^\infty$ annulus diffeomorphisms with finitely many periodic points and Diophantine boundary rotation number. Related results (Herman–Yoccoz circle conjugacy, pseudo-rotation theory, recent work on action/rotation numbers of periodic orbits of area-preserving annulus diffeomorphisms) address neighboring questions but do not appear to settle this conjugacy problem.

status_evidence.title: Action and rotation number of periodic orbits of area-preserving annulus diffeomorphisms
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work studying periodic orbits of area-preserving annulus diffeomorphisms; does not provide a smooth conjugacy theorem of the form sought.
status_evidence.claim: Recent related work on annulus diffeomorphisms does not resolve the conjugacy question.

status_evidence.title: Jean-Christophe Yoccoz and the theory of circle diffeomorphisms
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of Herman–Yoccoz smooth linearization for circle diffeomorphisms with Diophantine rotation number.
status_evidence.claim: The boundary circle restrictions are smoothly linearizable by Herman–Yoccoz, but extending the conjugacy to the full annulus is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: Pseudo-rotations of the closed annulus
status_evidence.snippet: Studies pseudo-rotations of the closed annulus; deals with approximation/conjugation issues but does not establish smooth rigidity in the stated setting.
status_evidence.claim: Pseudo-rotation literature does not establish the requested $C^\infty$ conjugacy.
